Name: Mayor Mod
Author: EmuEngine
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/PV6XvFb.png[/img]

[size=3] ﻿The[b] Mayor Mod[/b] lets you step into a leadership role in Pelican Town. Run for mayor in a local election, cast your vote, and take part in council meetings where you can make decisions that impact the town. Improve the community, work with villagers, and shape the future of Stardew Valley through local politics.[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/NirTj3g.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b][size=4]Run for election[/size][size=3] - [/size][/b][size=3]Register as a candidate and campaign across the valley. Build support by talking to villagers and showing your dedication to the town. The election outcome depends on your relationships and actions leading up to the vote.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Debate[/size][size=3] - [/size][/b][size=3]Join a live debate with Mayor Lewis. Answer questions, present your vision, and persuade the townspeople why you're the better choice for mayor. Your performance can influence the election results.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Town Hall[/size][size=3] - [/size][/b][size=3]Lewis has been using the old Town Hall as his personal space for years. Once you're elected, you'll reclaim it as a functional government building and center for town planning and decision making.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Council meetings [/size][size=3]- [/size][/b][size=3]Host and lead council meetings where you and other council members discuss and vote on town improvements. Make choices that affect Pelican Town's development and daily life.[/size]
[/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/Qp5YeED.png[/img]
[size=3] ﻿This mod is ideally installed at the start of a new game, but it is also safe to add during an ongoing playthrough.
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size][size=3] - ﻿[/size][size=3]The mod is designed with minimal dependencies. You should only need: [b]SMAPI[/b] & [b]Content Patcher.[/b][/size]
[*][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=3] - You can use a mod manager or manually install by:[/size]
[list][*][size=3]Download the main "[b]MayorMod.zip[/b]" file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open the .zip file with WinRAR or 7zip.[/size]
[*][size=3]Drag and drop the files inside to your mods folder. (If you're upgrading delete the old MayorMod folder first)[/size]
[*][size=3][b]DO NOT RENAME[/b] folders![/size]
[/list][/list]

[img]https://imgur.com/JBGK6fV.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]How to start[/b][/size][size=3] - You can start the mod by going to the Adventurer's Guild in the second year. (Full details in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33104/?tab=forum&topic_id=15809968]Frequently Asked Questions[/url])[/size]
[*][size=4][b]Future plans[/b][/size][size=3] - You can see pre-release versions on the [url=https://github.com/emuengine/StardewValleyMayorMod/releases]Github[/url] page﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][b]Discord[/b][/size][size=3] - Join the [url=https://discord.gg/qr2rPWzs6r]discord[/url] ﻿to discuss or get help with the mod. I usually just hang out there while working on the mod. [/size]
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/dJftbSI.png[/img]
[size=4]Known Issues:[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Story compatibility with Law & Order SV[/size]
[*][size=3]Story compatibility with Marnie x Marlon[/size]
[/list]

[size=3]I want to make this mod as compatible as possible though so let me know if you encounter any issues and Ill do my best to fix them.[/size]
